subject: Rapid pilot MAP — strawman and ops checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rapid pilot MAP — strawman and ops checklist

Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a strawman mutual action plan (MAP) and a short ops checklist to make the pilot run smoothly. I attached the GDoc and a 10-slide deck that summarizes milestones.

High level proposal (strawman):
- Pilot length: 6 weeks (2 weeks ingest and integration, 3 weeks model evaluation, 1 week handoff)
- Success criteria: 1) baseline latency within 150ms p95, 2) end-to-end feature coverage for the core use case, 3) qualitative quality score >= 85% on your evaluation set
- Key dependencies we need from BrightLane:
  - Data access: secure S3 bucket + sample dataset (<= 100k rows)
  - Security: point of contact for SOC2/infosec questionnaire
  - Stakeholders: engineering lead, product owner, and data privacy owner

Asks from you before our kickoff workshop:
1) Confirm the list of stakeholders and who will own each success criterion
2) Share a short data sample and the service account we can use for a sandbox environment
3) Any constraints on timing (do you prefer a compressed 4-week sprint vs. 6 weeks?)

Tentative dates: kickoff week of May 3, 2027 — 30 minute workshop to align stakeholders and agree on the MAP. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Attachments: [MAP_rapid-pilot_v1.gdoc (Google Doc - draft), MAP_rapid-pilot_deck_v1.gslides (10 slides)]

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@brightlane.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid pilot MAP — strawman and ops checklist

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan and the docs. This looks like a good starting point. A few quick notes from our side:
- Stakeholders: I'll loop in Noah Park (Eng Lead), Priya Shah (Product), and Samir Rao (Security) — they can join the kickoff.
- Data: we can provision a read-only S3 location with a sample extract by Friday (I'll send the link and service account).
- Timeline: we're interested in a faster turnaround if possible — would you be able to compress to a 4-week pilot? Our priority is to get a set of results before our Q3 planning window.

Also one ask: can the MAP explicitly call out rollback criteria and a lightweight acceptance checklist we can use for the final decision?

I can do a 30-minute kickoff on Tue May 4 between 10–12 PT or Wed May 5 after 1pm PT. Which works for your team?

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of Product, BrightLane
olivia@brightlane.ai | (415) 555-1212

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid pilot MAP — strawman and ops checklist

Olivia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the stakeholder names — that helps a lot. We're happy to do a compressed 4-week pilot. Revised high-level timeline (compressed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): alignment and infra handoff
- Week 1: data ingestion + baseline profiling (Dev lead + Redwood infra)
- Week 2: model evaluation and initial tweaks
- Week 3: end-to-end QA, acceptance checklist, and final report

I've updated the MAP doc to include rollback checkpoints and a one-page acceptance checklist (see link below). I also added a short risk register highlighting data security, sample fidelity, and quota limits.

Links/attachments:
- MAP_rapid-pilot_v1.gdoc (updated draft) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_rapid-pilot_v1
- MAP_rapid-pilot_deck_v1.gslides — https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_rapid-pilot_deck_v1

Marissa — can you own the acceptance checklist and the evaluation rubric? If you agree, I'll add you as the owner in the doc so BrightLane can see the point of contact.

Olivia — Tue May 4 10:30 PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff with the proposed agenda.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Rapid pilot MAP — strawman and ops checklist

Olivia / Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed the updated MAP and added a one-page acceptance checklist and a short evaluation rubric (quality, latency, integration completeness). Key items I added:
- Acceptance checklist (owner: Marissa Cole):
  1) End-to-end payloads processed in sandbox + no PII in sample
  2) p95 latency < 200ms in sandbox under typical request mix
  3) Accuracy threshold: >= 85% on prioritized prompt set (BrightLane to provide)
  4) Security sign-off: Samir Rao signs the light SOC2 checklist
  5) Deployment readiness: playbook for rollback and emergency contact list

- Workshop agenda (30 min):
  1) Introductions & objectives (5)
  2) Review MAP timeline & owners (10)
  3) Data handoff and infra checklist (8)
  4) Next steps & calendar (7)

I've attached the cleaned MAP doc (MAP_rapid-pilot_v1-clean.gdoc) and added comments where I need input from BrightLane (notably which prompts you want in the prioritized set).

Olivia — Tue May 4 at 10:30 PT is confirmed. I'll send the invite and a short prep note. If you have a preferred meeting link we can use your Zoom/meet.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0099
